title: Yuvomi
description: Self-hosted family planner: tasks, shared calendar with CalDAV/CardDAV, shopping, meals, budget, notes, contacts and health in one installable PWA on a single SQLite database. Source: https://github.com/ulsklyc/yuvomi

env.name: SESSION_SECRET
env.label: Session secret (required)
env.description: At least 32 random characters. Generate one with: openssl rand -hex 32. Changing it later signs everyone out once.

env.name: DB_ENCRYPTION_KEY
env.label: Database encryption key (required)
env.description: At least 32 random characters. Generate one with: openssl rand -hex 32. Keep a copy: the database and its backups only open with exactly this key.

env.name: OIKOS_HTTP_PORT
env.label: Host port for the web UI

env.name: BASE_URL
env.label: Base URL (recommended)
env.description: The address your household uses, e.g. https://yuvomi.example.com. Without it, password reset mails are never sent.

note: Set the session secret and the database encryption key before you deploy, and keep a copy of the key. Then open port 3000 (or the one you chose) and create your admin account. Behind an HTTPS reverse proxy, also set SESSION_SECURE=true. All other settings are listed in .env.example.
